description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class `Smarty_Template_Resource_Base`, which serves as a base for template resource classes in the Smarty templating system. It includes properties related to template compilation, caching, content, dependencies, and methods for processing the resource, rendering template code, and retrieving timestamps.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Resource_Base
classes.description: An abstract class providing the base implementation for Smarty template resource handling, including properties for file paths, timestamps, cache management, dependencies, and methods for processing and rendering template resources.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Abstract method to process the template resource, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getRenderedTemplateCode
methods.description: Retrieves rendered template content by executing the compiled or cached template function, handling callbacks and exceptions.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the template resource's timestamp, updating it via file modification time if necessary.
